methodDetails.scope: Supplemental frozen web test contract inventory indexes 2 through 17 inclusive, all 16 assigned files. Audit start timestamp is the actual start of this reviewer overall R7 inspection; this supplementary scope was added during the audit.
methodDetails.coverage: Read each complete generated contract including every test title, assertion, fixture, branch, lifecycle hook and side-effect entry, cross-checking current production behavior already reviewed. Inspected full high-risk test bodies for stale results/ABA ownership, security unknown outcomes, authentication suspension, original-receipt recovery, editable draft revisions, settings target isolation, attachment deletion ownership, keyboard/IME containment and nested dialogs. This is structural/contract review with targeted full-body reads, not a claim that every source line in every test was manually read.
highRiskBodyReads: app-lifecycle: storage failures, mutation persistence, explicit resume, tool mounts, authentication/draft/modal/attachment suspension and same-worker recovery
automations: original receipt recovery, edits after unknown creation, edited-restored revisions, remount and API/epoch/record ABA, malformed/foreign receipts and competing draft preservation
builtin-auth: all test bodies, MFA/setup/login/password/security outcomes and secret lifetimes
composer: all test bodies, navigation, asynchronous attachment removal, IME and disabled admission
device-login: all test bodies, owner handoffs, delayed completion and missing identity gates
dialog: all test bodies, keyboard/native-layer ownership, suspension and StrictMode
drafts: complete source, revision/ABA ownership, unsaved memory and capacity
execution-settings: all test bodies, target and original receipt identity, locked submitted fields and target changes
conversation: full callback ownership bodies including thread/epoch/API ABA, replacement API failure and StrictMode
methodDetails.checks: Independently parsed all 16 TSX source files with TypeScript 5.9.3: no syntax diagnostics. Checked current vitest.config.ts restoreMocks/clearMocks configuration to validate cleanup assumptions. No tests executed and no source changes. Browser geometry is not established by these jsdom contracts; the production clipping defect and CUA evidence are recorded solely in public-https-round7-web.json.
methodDetails.integrity: Recomputed all 16 file SHA-256 values against inventory.hashes and independently verified snapshot(undefined,true).digest matches the frozen complete 1883-file source digest.
